price_domain: Positive cent-valued OHLC paths around100 with independently sampled gaps, ranges and volumes; provided signals use the prior completed close.
coverage: Independent execution/accounting on supplied signals. All six setup clocks, valid trigger mappings, three entries, hard/close stops, all targets, costs/borrow/availability, weights, exposure/participation and mixed configuration competition are sampled. This is not detector, full dial or exhaustive pairwise certification.
expected_values: Calculated by verification/reference_execution.py; never copied from production. Per-seed input and comparison records are retained.
